clues.title: Engraved letter opener
clues.flavor: Marcus's initials on the handle. The blade is clean - too clean for what happened here. Someone wiped it down.

clues.title: Two wine glasses
clues.flavor: One glass, barely touched. A second, empty, with a faint lipstick trace on the rim. He wasn't drinking alone.

clues.title: Cold fireplace grate
clues.flavor: Ash, but no full pages - whatever burned here didn't burn all the way through. Someone was in a hurry, or interrupted.

clues.title: Overturned photo frame
clues.flavor: A photo of Marcus and Elena Voss at the gallery's opening night, face-down on the desk. Knocked over, or turned away deliberately?

clues.title: Bloodstain on the desk blotter
clues.flavor: A single stain, consistent with the letter opener. This is where it happened.
